# nepali-date-pro-max

> Bikram Sambat (Nepali) ↔ Gregorian (AD) date library for JS/TS. BS year range **1975–2099** (≈ AD 1918–2043). TypeScript-first, dual ESM+CJS, zero dependencies, MIT licensed. Three layers: functional core, immutable **Day.js-style** `NepaliDate` class with chainable locale switching, and a complete **date-fns-style** utility surface (100+ helpers). Ships with **calendar-grid builder**, cross-calendar **range conversion**, **fiscal-year** helpers, and **locale-driven time-ago / relative-time** helpers that accept `Date`/`number`/`string`/`NepaliDate`. Built-in `"en"` (Roman) and `"ne"` (Devanagari) locales, plus a `registerLocale()` extension point.

This file follows the [llms.txt convention](https://llmstxt.org/) and is structured for AI tools to pick the right symbol on the first try without trial and error.

---

## TL;DR — pick a function, write a line

```ts
import { /* ... */ } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
```

| You want to… | Use |
|---|---|
| Convert BS → AD | `bsToAd(year, month, day)` |
| Convert AD → BS | `adToBs(year, month, day)` |
| JS `Date` → BS | `fromJsDate(date)` or `NepaliDate.fromJsDate(date)` |
| Get current Nepal moment | `NepaliDate.now()` |
| Parse a BS string | `parseBs("2081-01-15")` (also `/`, `.`, Devanagari) |
| Format a BS date | `formatBs(bs, "YYYY-MM-DD")` or `instance.format(...)` |
| Render in Devanagari | `formatBs(bs, pattern, { locale: "ne" })` or `instance.locale("ne").format(pattern)` |
| Set the global locale | `NepaliDate.locale("ne")` (affects every later format/calendar/distance call) |
| **Build a calendar UI grid** | `getCalendarMonth(year, month, options?)` |
| Build full year of grids | `getCalendarYear(year, options?)` |
| Single-day cell metadata | `getCalendarDay(date, options?)` |
| Convert AD range → BS (bounds) | `convertAdRangeToBs(start, end, { format? })` |
| Convert AD range → BS (every day) | `eachBsDayInAdRange(start, end, { format? })` |
| Convert AD range → BS (every month) | `eachBsMonthInAdRange(start, end, { format? })` |
| Convert BS range → AD (bounds) | `convertBsRangeToAd(start, end, { format? })` |
| Convert BS range → AD (every day) | `eachAdDayInBsRange(start, end, { format? })` |
| **"X ago"** (always with suffix, locale-driven) | `formatDistanceToNow(input, options?)` — `options.locale` overrides global |
| **Duration between two moments** (no suffix) | `formatDistance(a, b, options?)` |
| **Smart relative** ("yesterday" / "हिजो" / "३ दिनमा") | `formatRelative(input, base?, options?)` |
| Coerce any input → `NepaliDate` | `toNepaliDate(input)` |
| Add / subtract calendar units | `addDays`, `addMonths`, `addYears`, `addHours`, `addMinutes`, `addSeconds`, `addMilliseconds` (and `subX`) |
| Set a field (immutably) | `setYear`, `setMonth`, `setDate`, `setDay`, `setDayOfYear`, `setHours`, `setMinutes`, `setSeconds`, `setMilliseconds` |
| Calendar bounds | `startOfDay`, `startOfWeek`, `startOfMonth`, `startOfYear` (and `endOf...`) |
| Compare two BS dates | `differenceInDays`, `differenceInMonths`, `differenceInYears`, `isBefore`, `isAfter`, `isSameDay`, `isSameMonth`, `isSameYear`, `isSameWeek` |
| Today-relative predicate | `isToday`, `isYesterday`, `isTomorrow`, `isThisMonth`, `isThisYear`, `isThisWeek` |
| Weekday / weekend | `isWeekend(d)` (Saturday only by default), `isMonday`, `isTuesday`, `isWednesday`, `isThursday`, `isFriday`, `isSaturday`, `isSunday` |
| Month-edge / leap | `isFirstDayOfMonth`, `isLastDayOfMonth`, `isLeapYear` |
| Interval ops | `isWithinInterval`, `areIntervalsOverlapping`, `eachDayOfInterval`, `eachWeekOfInterval`, `eachMonthOfInterval`, `eachYearOfInterval`, `eachWeekendOfInterval` |
| Min / max / clamp | `min(arr)`, `max(arr)`, `clamp(d, interval)`, `closestTo`, `closestIndexTo` |
| Fiscal year (आर्थिक वर्ष) | `getFiscalYear`, `startOfFiscalYear`, `endOfFiscalYear`, `formatFiscalYear`, `getFiscalQuarter` |
| Devanagari ↔ ASCII digits | `toDevanagariDigits(x)`, `toAsciiDigits(s)` |
| Days in BS month/year | `daysInBsMonth(y, m)`, `daysInBsYear(y)` |
| Check leap year (numeric) | `isBsLeapYear(y)` |

---

## Mental model (read once, save time later)

1. **All months are 1-indexed.** `1 = Baishakh / January`, `12 = Chaitra / December`. Never JavaScript's 0-indexed style.
2. **All dates are calendar values.** BS dates have no inherent timezone. The `NepaliDate` class additionally carries an optional time-of-day in **Asia/Kathmandu (UTC+05:45)** wall-clock.
3. **`NepaliDate` is immutable.** Every "mutating" method returns a NEW instance.
4. **Supported BS year range:** `1975` to `2099` inclusive. Out-of-range inputs throw `RangeError`.
5. **`Date` inputs are read as UTC fields.** `new Date("2024-04-13")` always means April 13. Pass `{year, month, day}` for explicit local-time semantics.
6. **Nepal-aware defaults:** week starts Sunday (`weekStartsOn: 0`); weekend = Saturday only (`[6]`).
7. **Distance/relative helpers are polymorphic.** They accept `NepaliDate | Date | number | string` for any date argument. Strings → Gregorian ISO via `new Date(string)`; for BS strings use `NepaliDate.parse()` first.

---

## Type signatures (verbatim)

### Core conversion
```ts
function bsToAd(year: number, month: number, day: number): { year: number; month: number; day: number };
function adToBs(year: number, month: number, day: number): { year: number; month: number; day: number };
function fromJsDate(date: Date): { year: number; month: number; day: number };
function bsWeekday(year: number, month: number, day: number): number;     // 0=Sun..6=Sat
function bsDayOfYear(year: number, month: number, day: number): number;   // 1..(365|366)
function bsFromDayOfYear(year: number, dayOfYear: number): { month: number; day: number };
function toNepaliDate(input: NepaliDate | Date | number | string): NepaliDate;
```

### Calendar metadata
```ts
const FIRST_BS_YEAR: 1975;
const LAST_BS_YEAR: 2099;
const ANCHOR_AD_YEAR: 1918;
const ANCHOR_AD_MONTH: 4;
const ANCHOR_AD_DAY: 13;
const BS_YEAR_DATA: readonly (readonly number[])[];
function daysInBsMonth(year: number, month: number): number;   // 29..32
function daysInBsYear(year: number): number;                    // 365 | 366
function isBsLeapYear(year: number): boolean;
```

### Names & digit helpers
```ts
const BS_MONTH_NAMES: readonly string[];          // ["Baishakh", "Jestha", ...]
const BS_MONTH_NAMES_SHORT: readonly string[];    // ["Bai", "Jes", ...]
const BS_MONTH_NAMES_NP: readonly string[];       // ["बैशाख", "जेठ", ...]
const AD_MONTH_NAMES: readonly string[];
const AD_MONTH_NAMES_SHORT: readonly string[];
const WEEKDAY_NAMES: readonly string[];           // 0=Sunday
const WEEKDAY_NAMES_SHORT: readonly string[];
const WEEKDAY_NAMES_MIN: readonly string[];
const WEEKDAY_NAMES_NP: readonly string[];
const WEEKDAY_NAMES_NP_SHORT: readonly string[];
const DEVANAGARI_DIGITS: readonly string[];
function toDevanagariDigits(input: number | string): string;
function toAsciiDigits(input: string): string;
```

### Parsing & formatting
```ts
interface FormatOptions { nepali?: boolean }
function formatBs(date: BsDateTime, pattern: string, options?: FormatOptions): string;
function parseBs(input: string): BsDate;
```

**Format tokens** (case-sensitive): `YYYY YY MMMM MMM MM M DD D dddd ddd dd HH H hh h mm m ss s A a` plus `[literal]` escapes.

### Calendar grid (the UI primitive)
```ts
interface CalendarDayCell {
  bs: BsDate;                       // { year, month, day } in BS
  ad: AdDate;                       // { year, month, day } in AD
  weekday: number;                  // 0=Sun..6=Sat
  weekdayName: string;              // "Saturday"
  weekdayNameNepali: string;        // "शनिबार"
  bsDay: number;                    // 1..32
  bsDayNepali: string;              // "१", "१५", "२५"
  adDay: number;                    // 1..31
  isCurrentMonth: boolean;          // false for adjacent-month padding
  isToday: boolean;
  isSaturday: boolean;
  isSunday: boolean;
  isWeekend: boolean;               // configurable via options.weekendDays
  date: NepaliDate;                 // for click handlers / arithmetic
}

interface CalendarWeek {
  weekNumber: number;               // 1-based within the BS month
  days: CalendarDayCell[];          // always exactly 7
}

interface CalendarMonth {
  year: number;                     // BS year
  yearNepali: string;               // "२०८१"
  month: number;                    // 1..12
  monthName: string;                // "Baishakh"
  monthNameNepali: string;          // "बैशाख"
  daysInMonth: number;              // 29..32
  firstDay: NepaliDate;
  lastDay: NepaliDate;
  weekdayHeaders: string[];         // 7 entries in weekStartsOn order
  weekdayHeadersShort: string[];
  weekdayHeadersMin: string[];
  weeks: CalendarWeek[];            // typically 5 or 6 weeks
}

interface CalendarMonthOptions {
  weekStartsOn?: number;            // 0..6, default 0 (Sunday)
  padding?: boolean;                // default true
  today?: NepaliDate;               // override "today"
  weekendDays?: readonly number[];  // default [6]
  locale?: string | Locale;         // overrides global; defaults to NepaliDate.locale()
}

function getCalendarMonth(year: number, month: number, options?: CalendarMonthOptions): CalendarMonth;
function getCalendarYear(year: number, options?: CalendarMonthOptions): CalendarMonth[];   // 12 entries
function getCalendarDay(date: NepaliDate, options?: { today?: NepaliDate; weekendDays?: readonly number[] }): CalendarDayCell;
function flattenCalendarMonth(month: CalendarMonth): CalendarDayCell[];
```

### Cross-calendar range conversion
```ts
type AdInput = AdDate | Date;

interface RangeConvertOptions {
  format?: string;                  // if set → returns string[] / { start, end } strings
  locale?: string | Locale;         // override locale for formatted output (defaults to global)
}

interface AdRangeFormatOptions {
  format?: string;                  // English-only AD formatting
}

function convertAdRangeToBs(start: AdInput, end: AdInput): { start: BsDate; end: BsDate };
function convertAdRangeToBs(start: AdInput, end: AdInput, options: RangeConvertOptions & { format: string }): { start: string; end: string };

function eachBsDayInAdRange(start: AdInput, end: AdInput): BsDate[];
function eachBsDayInAdRange(start: AdInput, end: AdInput, options: RangeConvertOptions & { format: string }): string[];

function eachBsMonthInAdRange(start: AdInput, end: AdInput, options?: RangeConvertOptions): BsDate[] | string[];

function convertBsRangeToAd(start: BsDate, end: BsDate, options?: AdRangeFormatOptions): { start: AdDate | string; end: AdDate | string };
function eachAdDayInBsRange(start: BsDate, end: BsDate, options?: AdRangeFormatOptions): AdDate[] | string[];
```

### Distance / relative (locale-driven, options-based)
```ts
type DateInput = NepaliDate | Date | number | string;

interface DistanceOptions {
  locale?: string | Locale;   // defaults to NepaliDate.locale() (global)
}

// Pure duration — NEVER includes a suffix
function formatDistance(a: DateInput, b: DateInput, options?: DistanceOptions): string;
// "5 days"  /  "५ दिन"

// Time vs. now — ALWAYS includes "ago" / "in" / "अघि" / "पछि" suffix
function formatDistanceToNow(input: DateInput, options?: DistanceOptions): string;
// "5 minutes ago"  /  "५ मिनेट अघि"

// Smart relative phrasing — "yesterday" / "today" / "in N days" / fallback to date
function formatRelative(date: DateInput, base?: DateInput, options?: DistanceOptions): string;
// "yesterday" / "हिजो" / "३ दिनमा"
```

**Suffix rule.** `formatDistance` is a pure duration; `formatDistanceToNow` always adds `ago`/`in` (or `अघि`/`पछि`) because the comparison is implicitly *to now*.

### Locale (Day.js-style: global default + per-instance/per-call override)
```ts
interface LocaleRelativeTime {
  lessThanMinute: string;
  minute(n: number): string;
  aboutHour(n: number): string; aboutDay(n: number): string;
  day(n: number): string;
  aboutMonth(n: number): string; month(n: number): string;
  aboutYear(n: number): string; almostYear(n: number): string;
  overYear(n: number): string;  year(n: number): string;
  ago(s: string): string; in(s: string): string;
  today: string; yesterday: string; tomorrow: string;
  inNDays(n: number): string; nDaysAgo(n: number): string;
}

interface Locale {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly months: readonly string[];          // 12, 0=Baishakh
  readonly monthsShort: readonly string[];     // 12
  readonly weekdays: readonly string[];        // 7, 0=Sunday
  readonly weekdaysShort: readonly string[];   // 7
  readonly weekdaysMin: readonly string[];     // 7
  readonly digits: (input: number | string) => string;
  readonly relativeTime?: LocaleRelativeTime;  // optional; falls back to "en"
}

// Built-in: "en" (Roman, ASCII digits) and "ne" (Devanagari).
function getGlobalLocale(): string;
function setGlobalLocale(name: string): void;
function getLocale(name: string): Locale;
function hasLocale(name: string): boolean;
function listLocales(): string[];
function registerLocale(locale: Locale): void;

// On the class — same shape as Day.js:
NepaliDate.locale();           // → current global name
NepaliDate.locale("ne");       // set global → returns the new name
d.locale();                    // → resolved locale on this instance (instance → global → "en")
d.locale("ne");                // → NEW instance with locale pinned (chainable)
```

### Fiscal year
```ts
const FISCAL_YEAR_START_MONTH: 4;   // Shrawan
function getFiscalYear(date: NepaliDate): number;
function startOfFiscalYear(fy: number): NepaliDate;
function endOfFiscalYear(fy: number): NepaliDate;
function formatFiscalYear(fy: number, options?: { locale?: string | Locale }): string;  // "2081/82" or "२०८१/८२"
function getFiscalQuarter(date: NepaliDate): number;                            // 1..4
```

### `NepaliDate` class
```ts
class NepaliDate {
  // factories
  static now(): NepaliDate;
  static fromBs(y, m, d, h?, min?, s?, ms?): NepaliDate;
  static fromAd(y, m, d, h?, min?, s?, ms?): NepaliDate;
  static fromJsDate(d: Date): NepaliDate;
  static parse(input: string): NepaliDate;

  // accessors
  getYear(): number; getMonth(): number; getDate(): number;
  getDay(): number;        // 0=Sun..6=Sat
  getDayOfYear(): number;
  getHours(): number; getMinutes(): number; getSeconds(): number; getMilliseconds(): number;
  getMonthName(): string;        // active locale's name
  getDayName(): string;          // active locale's name
  daysInMonth(): number; daysInYear(): number;

  // locale (Day.js-style)
  static locale(): string;
  static locale(name: string): string;
  locale(): string;
  locale(name: string): NepaliDate;

  // predicates
  isFirstDayOfMonth(): boolean;
  isLastDayOfMonth(): boolean;
  isLeapYear(): boolean;
  isWeekend(weekendDays?: readonly number[]): boolean;  // default [6]
  isBefore(other: NepaliDate): boolean;
  isAfter(other: NepaliDate): boolean;
  isSameDay(other: NepaliDate): boolean;

  // conversion
  toBs(): BsDate;
  toAd(): AdDate;
  toJsDate(): Date;
  toString(): string;     // "YYYY-MM-DD"
  toJSON(): { bs: BsDate; ad: AdDate; iso: string };
  getDetails(): NepaliDateDetails;

  // formatting (uses active locale unless options.locale overrides)
  format(pattern: string, options?: FormatOptions): string;

  // arithmetic — returns NEW instance
  addDays(n: number): NepaliDate;
  addMonths(n: number): NepaliDate;            // clamps day-of-month
  addYears(n: number): NepaliDate;
  addHours(n: number): NepaliDate;
  addMinutes(n: number): NepaliDate;
  addSeconds(n: number): NepaliDate;
  addMilliseconds(n: number): NepaliDate;
  startOfDay(): NepaliDate;
  endOfDay(): NepaliDate;
  startOfMonth(): NepaliDate;
  endOfMonth(): NepaliDate;
  startOfYear(): NepaliDate;
  endOfYear(): NepaliDate;

  // comparison
  diffDays(other: NepaliDate): number;
}
```

### Functional helpers (date-fns style)
```ts
// Arithmetic
addDays / subDays(date: NepaliDate, n: number): NepaliDate;
addMonths / subMonths(date: NepaliDate, n: number): NepaliDate;
addYears / subYears(date: NepaliDate, n: number): NepaliDate;
addHours / subHours(date: NepaliDate, n: number): NepaliDate;
addMinutes / subMinutes(date: NepaliDate, n: number): NepaliDate;
addSeconds / subSeconds(date: NepaliDate, n: number): NepaliDate;
addMilliseconds / subMilliseconds(date: NepaliDate, n: number): NepaliDate;

// Setters
setYear(d, year): NepaliDate;
setMonth(d, month): NepaliDate;
setDate(d, day): NepaliDate;
setDay(d, weekday, options?: { weekStartsOn?: number }): NepaliDate;
setDayOfYear(d, dayOfYear): NepaliDate;
setHours / setMinutes / setSeconds / setMilliseconds(d, value): NepaliDate;

// Comparisons
isBefore / isAfter / isEqual(a, b): boolean;
isSameDay / isSameMonth / isSameYear(a, b): boolean;
isSameWeek(a, b, options?: { weekStartsOn?: number }): boolean;
isToday / isYesterday / isTomorrow(d): boolean;
isThisMonth / isThisYear(d): boolean;
isThisWeek(d, options?: { weekStartsOn?: number }): boolean;
isSunday / isMonday / isTuesday / isWednesday / isThursday / isFriday / isSaturday(d): boolean;
isWeekend(d, options?: { weekendDays?: readonly number[] }): boolean;
isFirstDayOfMonth / isLastDayOfMonth / isLeapYear(d): boolean;
isWithinInterval(d, interval: NepaliInterval): boolean;
areIntervalsOverlapping(a: NepaliInterval, b: NepaliInterval): boolean;
isValid(value: unknown): value is NepaliDate;

// Bounds
startOfDay / endOfDay(d): NepaliDate;
startOfWeek / endOfWeek(d, options?: { weekStartsOn?: number }): NepaliDate;
startOfMonth / endOfMonth(d): NepaliDate;
startOfYear / endOfYear(d): NepaliDate;

// Differences
differenceInMilliseconds / differenceInSeconds / differenceInMinutes / differenceInHours(a, b): number;
differenceInDays / differenceInWeeks(a, b): number;
differenceInMonths / differenceInYears(a, b): number;                          // calendar-aware
differenceInCalendarDays / differenceInCalendarMonths / differenceInCalendarYears(a, b): number;

// Interval enumerators
eachDayOfInterval(interval): NepaliDate[];
eachWeekOfInterval(interval, options?: { weekStartsOn?: number }): NepaliDate[];
eachMonthOfInterval(interval): NepaliDate[];
eachYearOfInterval(interval): NepaliDate[];
eachWeekendOfInterval(interval, weekday?: number): NepaliDate[];               // default 6 (Saturday)

// Min / max / clamp
min(dates: readonly NepaliDate[]): NepaliDate | undefined;
max(dates: readonly NepaliDate[]): NepaliDate | undefined;
clamp(date: NepaliDate, interval: NepaliInterval): NepaliDate;
closestTo(target: NepaliDate, candidates: readonly NepaliDate[]): NepaliDate | undefined;
closestIndexTo(target: NepaliDate, candidates: readonly NepaliDate[]): number | undefined;
```

---

## Common patterns

### Today's date in Nepali (Day.js-style)
```ts
import { NepaliDate } from "nepali-date-pro-max";

// Option 1 — set globally once
NepaliDate.locale("ne");
NepaliDate.now().format("dddd, DD MMMM YYYY");
// → "शनिबार, १७ बैशाख २०८३"

// Option 2 — chain per call (no global state change)
NepaliDate.now().locale("ne").format("dddd, DD MMMM YYYY");
```

### Calendar UI grid (drop straight into JSX)
```tsx
import { getCalendarMonth } from "nepali-date-pro-max";

// Picks up the global locale from NepaliDate.locale(),
// or pass `{ locale: "ne" }` for a one-off.
const cal = getCalendarMonth(2081, 1, { locale: "ne" });
return (
  <>
    <h2>{cal.monthName} {cal.yearNepali}</h2>
    <div className="grid grid-cols-7">
      {cal.weekdayHeadersShort.map(h => <div key={h}>{h}</div>)}
      {cal.weeks.flatMap(w => w.days).map(c => (
        <div
          key={`${c.bs.year}-${c.bs.month}-${c.bs.day}`}
          className={[
            !c.isCurrentMonth && "muted",
            c.isToday && "today",
            c.isSaturday && "holiday",
          ].filter(Boolean).join(" ")}
        >
          <div>{c.bsDayNepali}</div>
          <div className="text-xs">{c.adDay}</div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  </>
);
```

### Time-ago — locale-driven
```ts
import { formatDistanceToNow, NepaliDate } from "nepali-date-pro-max";

// Accepts ms timestamp, JS Date, ISO string, or NepaliDate. Locale defaults
// to NepaliDate.locale(); pass { locale: "ne" } to override per call.
formatDistanceToNow(post.createdAt);                            // "5 minutes ago"
formatDistanceToNow(new Date("2024-04-13"));                    // "2 years ago"
formatDistanceToNow(Date.now() + 86_400_000);                   // "in 1 day"

formatDistanceToNow(Date.now() - 5 * 60_000, { locale: "ne" }); // "५ मिनेट अघि"
formatDistanceToNow(Date.now() + 86_400_000, { locale: "ne" }); // "१ दिन पछि"

// Or set the global once and skip the option everywhere:
NepaliDate.locale("ne");
formatDistanceToNow(Date.now() - 5 * 60_000);                   // "५ मिनेट अघि"
```

### AD form input → BS strings for backend
```ts
import { convertAdRangeToBs } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
const { start, end } = convertAdRangeToBs(form.startDate, form.endDate, { format: "YYYY-MM-DD" });
// start, end are BS strings
```

### Days until a deadline
```ts
import { NepaliDate, differenceInDays } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
differenceInDays(NepaliDate.fromBs(2081, 12, 30), NepaliDate.now());
```

### Fiscal-year report header
```ts
import { NepaliDate, getFiscalYear, formatFiscalYear } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
const fy = getFiscalYear(NepaliDate.now());
const label = formatFiscalYear(fy, { locale: "ne" }); // "२०८३/८४"
```

### Saturdays in a month
```ts
import { NepaliDate, eachWeekendOfInterval } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
const m = NepaliDate.fromBs(2081, 1, 1);
const saturdays = eachWeekendOfInterval(
  { start: m.startOfMonth(), end: m.endOfMonth() },
  6,
);
```

---

## Anti-patterns (what NOT to do)

| Don't | Do |
|---|---|
| ❌ Mutate a `NepaliDate` | ✅ Use the returned instance: `const next = d.addDays(7)` |
| ❌ Use 0-indexed months (JS `Date` style) | ✅ Always 1..12 (`Baishakh = 1`, `Chaitra = 12`) |
| ❌ Call `bsToAd(2200, …)` | ✅ Stay within `[FIRST_BS_YEAR, LAST_BS_YEAR]` (1975–2099) |
| ❌ Round-trip via `toString()` to keep time | ✅ Use `.format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss")` or `toJSON()` |
| ❌ `new NepaliDate(...)` with arbitrary args | ✅ Use the static factories (`fromBs`, `fromAd`, `parse`, …) |
| ❌ Pass a BS string to `formatDistance()` | ✅ Pre-parse with `NepaliDate.parse()`; strings are Gregorian ISO |
| ❌ Assume a JS `Date` uses local-time fields in range conversion | ✅ Range conversion reads **UTC** fields. For local, pass `{year, month, day}` |
| ❌ Concatenate Nepali month + ASCII year manually | ✅ Use `formatBs(bs, "DD MMMM YYYY", { locale: "ne" })` |
| ❌ Pass `{ nepali: true }` (removed in 2.0) or call `*Nepali` siblings | ✅ Use `{ locale: "ne" }` or chain `.locale("ne")` |
| ❌ Compute calendar grids day-by-day | ✅ Use `getCalendarMonth()` — UI-ready data shape with all flags pre-computed |

---

## Error contract

Every public function throws structured errors with descriptive English messages. Wrap in `try/catch` only at boundaries — internal use trusts the inputs.

| Condition | Throws |
|---|---|
| BS year outside `[1975, 2099]` | `RangeError` |
| Month not integer in `[1, 12]` | `RangeError` |
| Day not integer in valid month range | `RangeError` |
| Invalid AD calendar date (e.g. Feb 30) | `RangeError` |
| AD date before BS 1975-01-01 / after BS 2099-end | `RangeError` |
| `parseBs` fails to match `YYYY[-/.]MM[-/.]DD` | `RangeError` |
| `fromJsDate` argument not a `Date` | `TypeError` |
| `setMonth` / `setHours` etc. with out-of-range value | `RangeError` |
| `isWithinInterval` / `clamp` with reversed interval | `RangeError` |
| `formatDistance("not a date", …)` | `TypeError` |
| `formatDistance(NaN, …)` | `TypeError` |

---

## Complete export list

Every public symbol exported from `"nepali-date-pro-max"`. Listed verbatim so AI tools and Ctrl+F find them on the first try.

### Conversion
`bsToAd` · `adToBs` · `fromJsDate` · `bsWeekday` · `bsDayOfYear` · `bsFromDayOfYear` · `toNepaliDate`

### Calendar metadata
`FIRST_BS_YEAR` · `LAST_BS_YEAR` · `BS_YEAR_DATA` · `daysInBsMonth` · `daysInBsYear` · `isBsLeapYear` · `ANCHOR_AD_YEAR` · `ANCHOR_AD_MONTH` · `ANCHOR_AD_DAY`

### Names & digits
`BS_MONTH_NAMES` · `BS_MONTH_NAMES_SHORT` · `BS_MONTH_NAMES_NP` · `AD_MONTH_NAMES` · `AD_MONTH_NAMES_SHORT` · `WEEKDAY_NAMES` · `WEEKDAY_NAMES_SHORT` · `WEEKDAY_NAMES_MIN` · `WEEKDAY_NAMES_NP` · `WEEKDAY_NAMES_NP_SHORT` · `DEVANAGARI_DIGITS` · `toDevanagariDigits` · `toAsciiDigits`

### Parsing & formatting
`parseBs` · `formatBs`

### Locale
`Locale` · `LocaleRelativeTime` · `getGlobalLocale` · `setGlobalLocale` · `getLocale` · `hasLocale` · `listLocales` · `registerLocale`

### `NepaliDate` class
`NepaliDate` (statics: `now`, `fromBs`, `fromAd`, `fromJsDate`, `parse`, `locale`)

### Arithmetic (functional)
`addDays` · `subDays` · `addMonths` · `subMonths` · `addYears` · `subYears` · `addHours` · `subHours` · `addMinutes` · `subMinutes` · `addSeconds` · `subSeconds` · `addMilliseconds` · `subMilliseconds`

### Setters (immutable)
`setYear` · `setMonth` · `setDate` · `setDay` · `setDayOfYear` · `setHours` · `setMinutes` · `setSeconds` · `setMilliseconds`

### Comparisons / `is*`
`isBefore` · `isAfter` · `isEqual` · `isSameDay` · `isSameMonth` · `isSameYear` · `isSameWeek` · `isToday` · `isYesterday` · `isTomorrow` · `isThisMonth` · `isThisYear` · `isThisWeek` · `isWeekend` · `isSunday` · `isMonday` · `isTuesday` · `isWednesday` · `isThursday` · `isFriday` · `isSaturday` · `isFirstDayOfMonth` · `isLastDayOfMonth` · `isLeapYear` · `isWithinInterval` · `areIntervalsOverlapping` · `isValid`

### Bounds
`startOfDay` · `endOfDay` · `startOfWeek` · `endOfWeek` · `startOfMonth` · `endOfMonth` · `startOfYear` · `endOfYear`

### Differences
`differenceInMilliseconds` · `differenceInSeconds` · `differenceInMinutes` · `differenceInHours` · `differenceInDays` · `differenceInWeeks` · `differenceInMonths` · `differenceInYears` · `differenceInCalendarDays` · `differenceInCalendarMonths` · `differenceInCalendarYears`

### Interval enumerators
`eachDayOfInterval` · `eachWeekOfInterval` · `eachMonthOfInterval` · `eachYearOfInterval` · `eachWeekendOfInterval`

### Distance / relative (polymorphic inputs, locale-driven)
`formatDistance` · `formatDistanceToNow` · `formatRelative` · `toNepaliDate` · `DateInput` · `DistanceOptions`

### Min / max / clamp
`min` · `max` · `clamp` · `closestTo` · `closestIndexTo`

### Cross-calendar range conversion
`convertAdRangeToBs` · `convertBsRangeToAd` · `eachBsDayInAdRange` · `eachAdDayInBsRange` · `eachBsMonthInAdRange`

### Calendar grid (UI-ready)
`getCalendarMonth` · `getCalendarYear` · `getCalendarDay` · `flattenCalendarMonth`

### Fiscal year (आर्थिक वर्ष)
`getFiscalYear` · `startOfFiscalYear` · `endOfFiscalYear` · `formatFiscalYear` · `getFiscalQuarter` · `FISCAL_YEAR_START_MONTH`

### TypeScript types
`BsDate` · `AdDate` · `BsDateTime` · `NepaliDateDetails` · `NepaliInterval` · `FormatOptions` · `DateInput` · `DistanceOptions` · `Locale` · `LocaleRelativeTime` · `CalendarMonth` · `CalendarWeek` · `CalendarDayCell` · `CalendarMonthOptions` · `AdInput` · `RangeConvertOptions` · `AdRangeFormatOptions`

## Imports cheat sheet

```ts
// Pick what you need (tree-shakeable):
import { bsToAd, adToBs, formatBs, parseBs } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
import { addDays, isToday, eachDayOfInterval } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
import { NepaliDate } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
import { convertAdRangeToBs, eachBsDayInAdRange } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
import { getCalendarMonth, getCalendarDay } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
import { getFiscalYear, formatFiscalYear } from "nepali-date-pro-max";
import {
  formatDistance, formatDistanceToNow, formatRelative,
} from "nepali-date-pro-max";
import {
  registerLocale, getLocale, setGlobalLocale,
  type Locale, type LocaleRelativeTime,
} from "nepali-date-pro-max";

// CommonJS works too:
const { NepaliDate, addDays } = require("nepali-date-pro-max");
```
